name: student-budget-and-expense-tracker-monorepo
description: Student Budget and Expense Tracker - Full-stack Monorepo with Next.js and Express.js

scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: node -e "if (process.env.VERCEL) { require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); }"

author: Naledi Perseverance Mashabane (TUT)
